answer: Each fake identity must root one vine in a distinct plume of the gale, paying the k-th factorial of ember-seeds: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120. N fakes cost 4,037,913 for 10 and over 9x10^157 for 100, since factorials multiply with each new identity. Two vines rooted in the same plume strangle each other and both wither at the close, so clones cannot share one plume to split the toll.
